lage: Jule, your friend, on her own with Leo since Tom left. Thursday evening. On Sunday morning you want to help your brother move.
jule.open: can you take leo on sunday? the whole day. i have to get out
A: You know full well my brother's moving on Sunday.
B: The whole day? What are you planning to do?
B.reply: nothing. just nothing for once. can you or not?
C: Is it all getting too much for you right now?
C.reply: …yeah. i've been doing everything alone for weeks. i can't do this anymore.
D: Fine. I'll cancel on my brother, then.
E: I'm helping with the move till two. Then I'll take Leo.
E.reply.afterA: from two. ok. but i can't manage the morning.
E.reply.afterC: from two would already help. it's just the morning i can't manage.
E.reply: from two works. but i can't manage the morning.
F: Why not ask Tom? He's Leo's dad too.
F.reply: tom doesn't even pick up the phone.
R1: Sorry, that was snippy. I could take Leo from two.
R1.reply: it's fine. from two works. but i can't manage the morning.
G: You can still manage the morning, can't you?
G.reply: sure. i'll manage. bring him at two.
H: Okay, forget it. I'll take him the whole day.
H.reply: thank you. really. sorry about your brother.
I: Leo can come along to the move. Then he stays with me.
I.reply.warm: …to the move? he'll go wild. thank you. really.
R2: Sorry, that thing about Tom was dumb. I'll take Leo from two.
R2.reply: it's fine. from two helps. i'll get the morning sorted.
inner: Yesterday I yelled at Leo over a sock. That's not who I want to be.
